title: LightmapGI denoiser crashes the engine when baking a 3d scene with certain complexity with supersampling on old GPU
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads)

### Issue description

So it started when the crash happens when baking a scene (it has an imported 49MB fbx file) on my personal pc (GTX 1050 Ti). It doesn't crash before on my office (that uses GTX 1660). I then try to replicate it on a MRP. I tried a single chandelier model. it doesn't crash. But when the scene has 7 instantiated node of it, it does crashes. (it doesn't crash on 6 chandeliers). The crashes happens on the denosing part of the whole baking process.
Keep in mind the crash happens when supersampling **and** denoising is on (active) on the LightmapGI node. Interestingly, it does crash when the model is a single fbx containing 6 chandelier (not 1 model instantiated 6 times).

### Steps to reproduce

- have a GTX 1050 Ti (or maybe other low end gpu to test)
- download and open the MRP
- open the lightmap_gi.tscn scene
- select the LightmapGI node and click Bake Lightmaps
- check if it crashes the engine

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[supersampling-lightmap-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18799375/supersampling-lightmap-bug.zip)
